day_local: Xuska Quduus Andrew Dung-Lac, Wadaad, iyo Saxiibadiis, Shahiidiin
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiro.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu wuxuu u imanayaa inuu xukumo dhulka.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan beerta canabka ah ee xilliga goosashada. Wax walba way bislaadeen. Midhaha canabku waxay u muuqdaan kuwo culus oo macaan, iyagoo sugaya gacanta beeralayda si ay u soo goostaan. Waxaa jira xilli wax walba ay u bislaadaan inay u gudbaan marxalad cusub. Maanta, akhriska koowaad ee kitaabka Muujintii, waxaan aragnaa 'mid u eg Wiilka Aadanaha' oo fadhiya daruur cad, gacantiisana ku haysta manjo aad u fiiqan. Waxaa la yidhi, 'Use your sickle and reap the harvest, for the time to reap has come.' Tani waxay u muuqan kartaa sawir cabsi leh, laakiin bal u fiirso si qoto dheer. Goosashadu ma aha dhammaadkii nolosha, ee waa ururinta waxa ugu qaalisan ee Ilaah u diyaariyey gurigiisa. Waa xilligii midhaha la geyn lahaa meesha ugu nabdoon, meesha aanay dhib iyo cudur midna ka jirin.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa mid ka mid ah midhaha ugu quruxda badan ee Ilaah u beeray adduunkan. Wuxuu lahaa maskax aad u dhalaalaya, oo had iyo jeer ku mashquulsan hal-abuurka tiknoolajiyadda. Waxaan xusuustaa sida uu u jeclaa inuu ka hadlo 'con chim airlines'. Markuu ka hadlayey, indhihiisu waxay lahaayeen dhalaal aan la sharxi karin, dhoola caddayntiisu waxay ahayd mid qalbiyada qaboojisa. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aad u jecel inuu waalidkiis la wadaago riyooyinkiisa, xitaa kuwa ugu yar. Wuxuu ahaa wiil dadka kale ka fikirayey inta uu naftiisa ka fikirayey. Xusuuso markii uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu doonayo inuu dhiibo dhammaan lacagtii uu keydsaday si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayay. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ilaah ma eego waxa aan bixino, wuxuu eegaa sida aan u bixinno. Ben wuxuu bixiyay qalbigiisa oo dhan.

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu ka hadlayaa burburka macbudka. 'All that you see here–the days will come when there will not be left a stone upon another stone that will not be thrown down.' Tani waxay inoo sheegaysaa in wax kasta oo adduunkan ah ay yihiin kuwo ku meel gaar ah. Dhagaxyada, dhismayaasha, iyo xitaa jirkeena bini'aadamka, dhammaantood waa kuwo u baahan in lagu beddelo wax weligeed ah. Marka aan maanta ka fekerayno xanuunka iyo murugada shan bilood ka dib, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad dareemaysaan in dunidiinnu ay burburtay. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad dareemaysaan in 'dhagax kasta' la dumiyey. Laakiin bal u fiirso waxa Ciise yidhi ka dib: 'Do not be terrified.'

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil doonayay inuu bixiyo wax kasta oo uu haysto. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu dadka kale ka farxiyo, ha ahaato inuu la ciyaaro walaalkiis Ryan, ama inuu si xushmad leh ula hadlo dadka waaweyn. Wuxuu ahaa wiil 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka. Marka aan maanta ka fekerayno carshiga Ilaah, aynu xusuusanno inuu yahay kan inoo diyaariyey meel aan dhib lahayn, meel aan ilmo lahayn. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax kasta oo aan ahay, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata, fadlan igu soo booqo ruuxa qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horeyba u joogay, waxaana naftayda u hurayaa adiga gebi ahaanba. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo, wajigiisana ha idiin iftiimiyo. Nabadda Masiixu ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, in Rabbigu uu siiyo nasasho weligeed ah oo uu ku iftiimiyo wejigiisa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa xanuunka haya, in Ilaah uu siiyo qalbi dagan, rajo, iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha iyagoo isku halaynaya jacaylkiisa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Aniga, Yooxanaa, waxaan eegay, oo waxaan arkay daruur cad, oo mid u eg Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa ku fadhiyey daruurta, isagoo madaxiisa ku sita taaj dahab ah, gacantiisana ku haysta manjo aad u fiiqan. Malaa'ig kale ayaa ka soo baxday macbudka, iyadoo cod dheer ugu qaylinaysa kan daruurta ku fadhiya, 'Isticmaal manjadaada oo goosashada soo guri, waayo xilligii goosashada ayaa la gaadhay, maxaa yeelay beeraha dhulka ayaa si buuxda u bislaaday.' Markaas kii daruurta ku fadhiyey ayaa manjadiisii u lulay dhulka, dhulkuna waa la goostay. Kadib malaa'ig kale ayaa ka soo baxday macbudka samada, iyaduna waxay haysatay manjo aad u fiiqan. Kadib malaa'ig kale oo ka timid meesha allabariga, oo mas'uul ka ahayd dabka, ayaa cod dheer ugu qaylisay middii haysatay manjada fiiqan, 'Isticmaal manjadaada fiiqan oo ka gooy canabka beerta dhulka, waayo canabkiisu waa bislaaday.' Markaas malaa'igtii waxay manjadeedii u lulatay dhulka, wayna goysay canabkii dhulka. Waxayna ku tuurtay mashiinka weyn ee canabka lagu cadaadiyo ee cadhada Ilaah.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu u imanayaa inuu xukumo dhulka. Dhexda quruumaha ku dhawaaq: Rabbigu waa boqor. Wuxuu adkeeyey dunida, aan la dhaqaajin karin; wuxuu dadka u xukumaa si caddaalad ah. Rabbigu wuxuu u imanayaa inuu xukumo dhulka. Jannada ha faraxdo, dhulkuna ha rayrayo; badda iyo wixii ka buuxa ha guuxeen; beeraha ha ku farxeen iyo wixii ku dhex jira! Markaas geedaha kaynta oo dhami way rayrayn doonaan. Rabbigu wuxuu u imanayaa inuu xukumo dhulka. Rabbiga hortiisa, waayo wuu imanayaa; waayo wuxuu u imanayaa inuu xukumo dhulka. Wuxuu dunida ku xukumi doonaa caddaalad iyo dadka daacadnimadiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Iyadoo dad qaarkood ay ka hadlayeen sida macbudka loogu sharraxay dhagaxyo qaali ah iyo qurbaanno, Ciise wuxuu yidhi, 'Waxaas oo dhan oo aad halkan ku aragtaan–maalmo ayaa iman doona oo aan dhagax dushiisa dhagax kale looga tegi doonin, kaas oo aan la dumin doonin.' Markaasay weydiiyeen, 'Macallimow, goormuu waxan dhici doonaa? Maxaase calaamad u noqon doona marka waxyaalahan oo dhami ay dhici doonaan?' Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Iska jira inaan laydin khiyaanin, waayo dad badan ayaa iman doona magacayga, iyagoo leh, "Aniga weeye," iyo "Waqtigii waa la gaadhay." Ha raacina iyaga! Markaad maqashaan dagaallo iyo kicin, ha cabsanina; waayo waxyaalahan waa inay dhacaan marka hore, laakiin dhammaadku isla markiiba ma iman doono.' Kadib wuxuu ku yidhi iyaga, 'Quruun baa quruun kale kacaysa, boqortooyona boqortooyo kale. Waxaa jiri doona dhulgariirro waaweyn, abaaro, iyo masiibooyin meel kasta; oo aragtiyo cabsi leh iyo calaamado waaweyn oo samada ka iman doona.'

day: Memorial of Saint Andrew Dung-Lac, Priest, and Companions, Martyrs

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
